findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_loans, get_loan · Private data: search_loans, program_facts, hud_stats, hap_expirations, hud_changes, hud_checklist · Public sink: wage_determination.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_loans, get_loan · Private data: search_loans, program_facts, hud_stats, hap_expirations, hud_changes, hud_checklist · Public sink: wage_determination

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
